region:calabarzon.note: The bars show how much each of five factor groups (Market / Prices, Climate Stress, Fish Kill, Employment and OFW Remittance) contributed to this forecast. The five shares add up to 100 percent. A long bar does not by itself mean that a factor raised the risk: the colour of each bar shows whether that factor raised or lowered the forecast. Driver shares come from how much each input of the E36 model moved this forecast: Market / Prices from the provincial food and rice price inputs, and the model's news inputs are assigned to the five drivers by the topic of the news titles behind them, so a driver with no matching news shows 0 percent. Part of the forecast also depends on the regional hunger survey, the latest published risk level and news that matches no driver; that part is not shown in the five groups. These figures are model estimates, not official government statistics.
